# FinAuto Client Documentation

FinAuto Client is a Windows desktop application for importing trial balances from Tally or Excel, coding ledgers, and generating Schedule III–ready financial statements with fixed assets, share capital, and aging modules.

## AI corpus (operators)

After `mkdocs build`, RAG chunks are exported to `site/ai/corpus.jsonl` (not published to GitHub Pages by default). Use `scripts/validate_corpus.py` and `scripts/rag_smoke.py` before enabling agent ingestion.

Support: support@finautoindia.com — do not share API keys or PAN in email.
